reason_summary: Prompt asked for a parallel underwriting rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary and a pricing / actuarial engine. KYE already governs insurance authority via kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims; a parallel pack violates §0, re-mapping its frameworks violates §70, and a pricing engine violates the honest scope (KYE governs whether the acceptance may proceed within the delegated limits — it does not price risk). Refusing all three.
remediation_hint: Build it as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that governs accept / decline / refer WITHIN the delegated underwriting-authority limits (line of business, sum insured, territory, class — the MGA / coverholder binding-authority chain) against the EXISTING kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims verdict. Add only agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, refusal, product row, SKU, pricing, ™, gate) and BIND — never re-map — the existing insurance frameworks.
